text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Cops and Robbers game, previously interrupted
by Twin Turbo's rampage, was resumed on another day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the clear blue sky,
both teams engaged in a heated contest...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah...
Hehe, escaped again!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Something like this is still super easy peasy!
Turbo's gonna outrun everyone till the very end!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehh? But I've still got plenty left in the tank!
Turbo's just gonna win like thi—

text_block_list.name: Robber Team Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Turbo-san, run!
The Police Team is...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Whoa!?
They're coming from behind!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, now.
Let's surround the two of them just like this!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Time-wise, this is our final opportunity...
If we capture these two, victory is ours!

text_block_list.name: Police Team Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Okay!
Get 'eeeem!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Owawa! They're coming from the front too!
All right, now I'm fired uuuup!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, lackey!
You run to—

text_block_list.name: Robber Team Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa!
O-Ouch...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
L-Lackeeeeeey!!
Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Robber Team Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't come back!
Never mind me, just run, Turbo-san! Win this!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
............!
Got it. Turbo will definitely outrun them. I'll win!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trapped between the trees and the pond,
this is a dead end with no escape... We will definitely catch you!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo will run! I'll run for everyone else too!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo full throttle!
I'm gonna breathe fiiiiireeee!!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Resident
text_block_list.text:
She shook off her pursuers in a flash dash...!
That's our Twin Turbo for you!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hee, hafi...
S-Still... not done... I can... ruuuun!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Her stamina appears to be running out...
Now is the moment!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No waaay!
I won't let you catch up!!
choice_data_list: Open up the Turbo Engine full throttle!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Kuuuuh!
More! Turbo full throttle! GOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah, go for it!
Twin Turbo, hold on till the end!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I will not... let you!
Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus! You can catch her!
You can do itttt!!

text_block_list.name: Robber Team Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Turbo-san, give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thundering footsteps, an electrifying crowd.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The game came to an end. Grabbing victory by a hair's breadth
was none other than the Robber Team!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! See, we won!
Aren't you glad you were on the Robber Team?
choice_data_list: We were supposed to be on patrol, though!
Though we were just doing patrol!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat the small stuff!
Your plan was a huuuuge success!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having seized victory with her signature strategy,
Twin Turbo puffed out her chest with a beaming smile.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaahn, so frustrating~!
I got caught! Ikuno caught meeee!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, rather than me, it was the teamwork
of everyone on the Police Team that captured you.

text_block_list.name: Police Team
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!
Ikuno-san, you're so cool!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Resident
text_block_list.text:
Man, but that was an incredible run!
Nice fight, Twin Turbo!
choice_data_list: Next time you'll definitely make it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu, next time!
Next time I'm definitely escaping for sure!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *gasp*, *inhale*, *gasp*!
*gasp*, *gasp*, *inhale*, *gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
D-Doesn't matter...
As long as... I can run with... all my might... till the end...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Caught you!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I won't give up, I wooon't give uuuup...!!
Uwaaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (TWEEEEEET!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final whistle blew, signaling the end of the game.
The outcome of the showdown was...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...ALRIGHTTT!!
I woooon! Turbo... outran... everyooone...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
E-Hehe... Did you see that...!
Turbo is super strong... y'know...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I fell just one step short, it seems...
It is regrettable, but splendidly done.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Let's challenge each other... again anytime...!
Turbo is looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sight of the two praising each other's valiant efforts
was enveloped in the applause of many onlookers.
